headline: AI Engineer building production LLM systems
summary: Entry-level AI engineer with 1.5 years of experience shipping retrieval-augmented LLM applications. Comfortable across the stack: FastAPI services, evaluation harnesses, vector search and clean data pipelines. Looking for a product team where I can own agent reliability end to end.

preferences.notes: Prefer small product teams. Open to remote roles overlapping 4+ hours with PKT.

experiences.title: Junior AI Engineer
bullets: Built a FastAPI retrieval service over 12,000 internal documents using LangChain and OpenAI embeddings, serving 300 queries per day.
Cut median retrieval latency by 42% by adding a Redis cache and batching embedding requests.
Wrote an evaluation harness with 120 labelled queries that raised answer accuracy from 71% to 89%.
Added Pydantic validation, structured logging and retry handling to the LLM pipeline.

experiences.title: Machine Learning Intern
bullets: Trained a scikit-learn churn model on 50,000 customer records, reaching 0.86 ROC-AUC.
Built pandas preprocessing pipelines that reduced feature preparation time from 3 hours to 20 minutes.
Presented weekly experiment results to a 6-person product team.

experiences.title: Freelance Backend Developer
bullets: Delivered four Flask and PostgreSQL APIs for small businesses, with pytest coverage above 80%.
Automated weekly CSV reporting with Python, saving roughly 6 hours of manual work per week.

education.institution: National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST)
education.details: CGPA 3.6/4.0. Final year project: an MCP-powered job search agent with a claim verifier.
